Avoid this place if you care about your pet's safety. I brought my dog here and they completely botched the haircut I asked for. Worse, they left him with minor cuts in highly sensitive areas, and he has been suffering for weeks because of it. This isn't the first time they've been careless, and I will definitely not be returning.

I brought my 13yo dog in for a much needed spa day, and they treated him like a puppy again! They gave him a fantastic bath, an excellent haircut, and somehow managed to brush his notoriously stinky oldman teeth. He came home looking handsome, smelling amazing, and strutting around like he was years younger. The staff was patient, gentle, and clearly cared about making a senior dog comfortable. I couldn’t be happier with the care they gave my old guy. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a groomer who treats your pet like family!
